newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Thirteen burnt to death in Malaysia bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Thirteen burnt to death in Malaysia bus crash.

text.p: - Thirteen people were burnt to death and 12 were injured when a tourist bus collided with a truck in Malaysia on Tuesday, the national Bernama news agency said.
The victims were believed to be all from Singapore, Roslan Dollah, deputy police chief of the town of Hulu Langat, was quoted as saying by Bernama.

The news agency said the bus was on its way to the hilltop casino resort of Genting Highlands, about 60 km (36 miles) north of the Malaysian capital of Kuala Lumpur when it smashed into a truck parked on the side of the highway.
Both vehicles then burst into flames, Roslan said.
